basis: per opened leg, measured WITHIN markets, reconciling only
excluded_because: a market whose venue and ledger quantities disagree is refused every per-unit rate: its residual units may be a missed fill rather than a flat book, which would put loss in the numerator against no units in the denominator

confirmed_credits.mapping_is_approximate: rebates accrue on maker NOTIONAL; we hold a per-fill figure and scale it by this cohort's fills-per-leg. The break-even is therefore a RANGE, not a point.
confirmed_credits.rewards_are_zero_because: every liquidity-reward row is SKIPPED or PENDING; accrued face value is never revenue

per_market_crosscheck.warning: CONTAMINATED AND KEPT ANYWAY. Every venue-confirmed market is negative and every derived market positive partly BY CONSTRUCTION: a market that pairs to zero leaves no residual to settle, so the venue never publishes a realizedPnl for it and it can only appear on the derived side. Read the per-leg basis above; this is here so the weaker cut can be argued with rather than hidden.

breakeven.range_reading: the two figures BRACKET the answer: the credit mapping is approximate, so the truth sits between them
breakeven.verdict: BELOW BREAK-EVEN on both ends of the range

marginal_value.reading: a residual unit costs 5.8x what a matched pair earns, which is why completion rate dominates every other lever measured so far
